scope: Opaque sRGB light-theme candidate tokens and explicitly intended pairings; not rendered UI certification.

sources.depth: Relevant contrast, luminance, use-of-color, focus, reflow and target-size sections only; not whole-standard review
Relevant UI-boundary, focus-adjacency and inactive-component guidance

sources.role: Informative explanation of AAA focus appearance; no geometry test performed

palettes.name: Mineral / Ink
palettes.character: Cool paper, dense ink, petrol actions; a legible research instrument rather than a brokerage terminal.

palettes.name: Aubergine / Frost
palettes.character: A restrained violet action accent and cool paper; more distinctive but needs care beside critical-event and replay labels.

palettes.name: Graphite / Copper
palettes.character: Warm graphite and a restrained copper action accent; avoid turning all surfaces beige or using decorative italic-serif headlines.

semantic_rules.brand_action: Navigation/interaction only, never a risk score or price trend.
semantic_rules.severity: Text label plus distinct icon/position; importance is not price direction or source health.
semantic_rules.evidence_strength: Neutral ink typography and disclosed 0-100 heuristic method; unavailable has no fabricated score. No rainbow/gauge/probability styling.
semantic_rules.price_direction: Signed values and words supply meaning; green/red only supplement price movement, never indicate safe/unsafe assets.
semantic_rules.data_mode_and_health: Reserved source/date band with explicit mode/coverage label; source freshness is not investment safety. Essential limitation text is active text, never disabled contrast.
semantic_rules.sector_or_series: Categorical legend/name and line pattern or direct label; color carries no good/bad or severity meaning. Adjacent-series differentiation remains a rendered chart task.

pairing_policy.focus_construction: 3px external opaque focus outline with 2px surface-colored offset; tested only on listed light surfaces. This contrast calculation does not test actual area, clipping or obscuration.
